response.justification: Bogdan is a seasoned generalist with 13+ years of experience, a CS degree, and credible depth in distributed, high-throughput systems (Sociomantic/Dunnhumby handling millions of requests per second) plus strong testing and craftsmanship practices. However, the role is a Principal/IC6 position centered on growth and experimentation systems, and the resume shows no experience with experimentation platforms, feature flagging, A/B testing, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or statistical analysis — the core of the job. His trajectory is senior/staff IC at small-to-mid companies rather than principal-level, multi-workstream leadership at enterprise scale, and there is no evidence of cross-org influence or ownership of platforms used by many teams. Language fit is partial (JS/TS, C/C++, Java, C# touched, but no Python and heavy D specialization).
strengths: 13+ years across web, backend, mobile, and embedded with CS degree
Real low-latency, high-volume distributed systems experience (ad tech)
Strong testing/TDD, tooling, and open-source/community leadership
concerns: No experimentation, A/B testing, or feature-flighting platform experience
No demonstrated telemetry/metrics infrastructure or statistical analysis depth
Scope and title track below Principal/IC6 enterprise-scale leadership

key_factors.factor: Insufficient principal-level scope and cross-org influence
Deep general engineering and high-scale service experience
